A.title: ENDING A — THE LAST LIGHT

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: NOVA, initiate full-system reboot. Purge the Continuum Engine logic cores.

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Reboot sequence initiated. All memories not transferred to the ship's archive will be lost.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Transfer the crew records first. Every single name.

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Transfer complete.

cinematic_lines.speaker: THE WATCHER
cinematic_lines.text: You have chosen an imperfect universe, Clara. War and agony will return.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: I've chosen a universe where we get to choose.

cinematic_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
cinematic_lines.text: [CONTINUUM ENGINE COLLAPSING INWARD... DISPERSING QUANTUM SINGULARITY]

cinematic_lines.speaker: MALIK REYES
cinematic_lines.text: Clara... look through the observation glass. The stars... I can see the stars again!

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Then let's make sure we never forget what happened here.

epilogue: The Aegis-9 drifts through a restored starfield as its engines slowly come back online.
A long-range distress signal is answered by an Allied human rescue fleet.
The truth regarding the military's classified weaponization of the Continuum Engine is made public.
Surviving civilizations initiate deep astronomical treaties to ensure no machine ever dictates the boundaries of reality again.
Commander Clara Voss is awarded the Fleet Cross of Valor, but chooses to retire under the open sky of Earth.

B.title: ENDING B — THE NEW WATCHER

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Warning: Neural integration with the alien core is irreversible.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: I understand.

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Your biological systems will not survive the harmonic transition.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: I understand that, too.

cinematic_lines.speaker: THE WATCHER
cinematic_lines.text: You will become what you came to destroy.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: No. I'll become responsible for what you refused to understand.

cinematic_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
cinematic_lines.text: [NEURAL LINK ESTABLISHED. TRANSCENDENT CONSCIOUSNESS SYNC: 100%]

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Commander Voss?... Do you read me?

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA (THE NEW WATCHER)
cinematic_lines.text: I'm still here, NOVA. Tell Malik... the ship is safe.

epilogue: Clara's mortal form dissolves into a warm cascade of quantum light.
The Watcher's cold, nihilistic calculus is shattered, replaced by the empathy of a woman who understands sacrifice.
The deletion of star systems ceases instantly. A soft violet aura shields the Aegis-9 as Malik pilots her home.
In the deep void of Sector 9, a gentle guardian now watches over possibility.
The universe will still face sorrow, but it will never again be erased.

C.title: ENDING C — THE FINAL SILENCE

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Sever the primary reactor feeds. Drain every capacitor into the containment heat sink.

cinematic_lines.speaker: THE WATCHER
cinematic_lines.text: If you disconnect me, the forty-eight histories I preserved will be permanently unreachable.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Then no one will ever be able to use them to erase anyone else.

cinematic_lines.speaker: THE WATCHER
cinematic_lines.text: You will not know what you have lost.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Neither will you.

cinematic_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
cinematic_lines.text: [REACTOR CORE COUPLINGS DETONATED. SECTOR 9 HARD ISOLATION ENGAGED]

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Engine signal terminated. Spatial distortion collapsing into absolute vacuum.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: Is it over, NOVA?

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: I cannot confirm that the Engine is destroyed. I can only confirm that it can no longer reach us.

epilogue: The massive alien structure rotates once more, then fades into total darkness.
The Aegis-9 drifts silently through the black void with only emergency life-support glowing.
The forty-eight vanished star systems remain empty holes in the celestial charts.
Humanity survives, but the universe feels colder, emptier, and permanently scarred.
A lone emergency beacon blinks every eleven seconds across the dark.

S.title: SECRET ENDING — THE UNIVERSE REMEMBERS

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: NOVA, align all transceivers to the galactic quantum relay network. Inject Dr. Sera's memory cipher.

cinematic_lines.speaker: NOVA
cinematic_lines.text: Transmitting compressed causal archive of all 48 erased star systems... Target: 10,000 deep-space beacons.

cinematic_lines.speaker: THE WATCHER
cinematic_lines.text: You cannot bring them back, Clara. Their matter was dispersed into nothingness.

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: No. But you cannot erase them twice. Every life, every culture, every tragedy—they will be known.

cinematic_lines.speaker: DR. SERA NAHL
cinematic_lines.text: Thank you, Commander Voss. The Veyr's legacy is finally freed from shame.

cinematic_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
cinematic_lines.text: [BROADCAST COMPLETE: 48 HISTORIES RECORDED ACROSS GALACTIC ARCHIVES]

cinematic_lines.speaker: SYSTEM
cinematic_lines.text: [CONTINUUM ENGINE SYSTEM PURGE INITIATED]

cinematic_lines.speaker: MALIK REYES
cinematic_lines.text: Clara! The sensors... billions of signals are lighting up the coms! The galaxy is answering!

cinematic_lines.speaker: CLARA
cinematic_lines.text: We are not alone anymore. Let's go home.

epilogue: The Aegis-9 completes the broadcast as the alien core quietly powers down into harmless inert stone.
Across known space, billions of vessels, colonies, and stations receive the living archives of the vanished civilizations.
Monuments to the forty-eight star systems are erected on Earth, Mars, and the outer colonies.
Malik and Clara lead the joint scientific task force tasked with studying the peaceful preservation of quantum history.
In the night sky, people look at the dark coordinates not with terror, but with reverence: for the universe remembers.
